title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news, not informed.
body:
It is easy to blame the algorithm for this, but the real problem is that we treat information consumption like a firehose. We scroll through everything, hoping that by sheer volume, we will somehow absorb what matters. It rarely works.

The truth is that we are all interested in different things. A software engineer, a small business owner, and a student have different priorities. When news is presented as a one-size-fits-all feed, it is bound to miss the mark for everyone.

Personalised news is not about filtering out the world to create an echo chamber. It is about filtering out the noise so you can actually engage with the topics that shape your specific life and work. When you cut through the clutter, you stop skimming and start understanding.

We built Headlinne to solve this. We use AI to help you find the stories that are relevant to you, not just the ones that generate the most clicks. It is a better way to stay sharp without the burnout.
cta: You can see how we are doing it at HEADLINNE.com.
